In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the artificial damping term in MG methods is a simple and powerful technique that makes the coarse grid problems much easier to solve.
, the artificial damping is a very useful tool in the MG methods.
, in many situations, the coarse grid operator of a MG method can be modified by a slight artificial damping, and the overall convergence rate is still maintained.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed MG method is a good candidate for solving highly oscillatory problems with a relatively coarse mesh, and it is especially useful for problems with a huge coarse grid problem.
, for a MG scheme, the coarse grid correction is the most time-consuming part of the MG method, and the artificial damping is an effective tool for speeding up the MG scheme.
, if we are interested in the solution of a highly oscillatory problem, then we can solve it with an MG method by adding an artificial damping term to the coarse grid problem.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the MG method with the artificial damping can be used for a wide class of problems, including problems with oscillatory solutions, without any special treatment.
, for the MG methods to be efficient in solving oscillatory problems, the coarse grid problems must be modified by a damping term, and the damping term must be carefully chosen.
